summary: Plains All American Pipeline, L.P. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering a $1.5 billion offering of fixed-to-fixed reset rate junior subordinated notes due 2056: $700 million of 6.750% Series A Notes and $800 million of 7.000% Series B Notes. Interest accrues from September 14, 2026, payable semi-annually beginning June 15, 2027; each series is reset to five-year Treasury plus spreads of 2.141% and 2.167%, respectively, subject to rate floors. The notes are unsecured, subordinated to senior indebtedness, unguaranteed, and carry optional interest deferral of up to 20 semi-annual periods. No special-situation event; this is a routine capital-markets takedown.
